## About
Not a casino. A card house off South Congress where you'll see familiar faces, bring your own drinks, and find a 1/2 game running until the last table breaks. We're a private social club that works within Texas law for card rooms, so it's safe and legal, and we'll spread other games when there's interest.
We're in the South Congress Plaza between Stassney and William Cannon, with plenty of parking. It's the easy drive from downtown, South Austin, or Buda and Kyle. An armed security guard is on site and will walk you to your car.
Water and coffee are on us, there are vending machines for snacks, and you're welcome to bring your own food and drinks. Big TVs around the room keep the game on between hands.

## Services
- 1/2 No Limit Hold'em: The most popular game in the room ($100 to $500 buy-in)
- 1/3 No Limit Hold'em: Deeper stacks ($200 to $1,000, or match the big stack)
- 2/5 No Limit Hold'em: Bigger game ($300 to $1,000 buy-in)
- 1/2/5 PLO or Big O: Pot Limit Omaha, with optional bomb pots ($200 to $700 buy-in)
- Monday: Round and Round freeroll, $2,000 guaranteed ($30)
- Tuesday: Freeroll, $1,500 guaranteed ($30)
- Wednesday: Freeroll with bomb pots, $2,000 guaranteed ($30)
- Thursday: Freeroll, $2,000 guaranteed ($30)
- Friday: Freeroll, $3,000 guaranteed ($30)
- Saturday: Freeroll, $2,000 guaranteed ($30)
- Sunday: Freeroll, $1,500 guaranteed ($30)
- Daily: Good for the day you buy it, 18 and up ($10)
- Monthly: 30 days of access ($30)
- Annual: 365 days, the best deal for regulars ($200)
- Cash game time: Loaded on your Poker Atlas card and billed to the minute. Tournaments are one flat fee. ($12 an hour)

## FAQ
Q: Is it legal to play poker here?
A: Yes. Shuffle 512 is a private social club that works within Texas law for card rooms. Every player is a member, and the house never takes a rake from the pot.

Q: How do I become a member?
A: Stop by the front desk, fill out the membership agreement and pick a plan: $10 for the day, $30 for 30 days, or $200 for a year. You have to be 18 or older.

Q: How do cash game fees work?
A: You load time onto your Poker Atlas player card. The dealer clocks you in when you sit and out when you leave, and it's billed to the minute, usually $12 an hour.

Q: Do tournaments charge by the hour?
A: No. Tournaments have one flat entry fee, like a greens fee at a golf club. Most nightly freerolls are $30.

Q: Can I bring food and drinks?
A: Yes. We don't have a kitchen or bar, so BYOB and bring or order food. Water and coffee are free, and there are vending machines.

Q: How late are you open?
A: We open at 11am every day and stay open until the last table breaks. Games often run all night, so check Poker Atlas or call.

Q: Can you deal a game that isn't listed?
A: Tell the floor what you want to play. If there's interest, we'll spread it.

Q: Is there anything I should know before I come?
A: No weapons, no smoking or vaping inside, and no phones while you're in a hand. All games follow TDA rules.

It's obviously not the biggest or fanciest room in town. No  food/bar or anything like that (except vending machines). But they let you bring your own food and drinks, and somehow the atmosphere ends up being way more enjoyable than a lot of places that spend money on all the extras.

The cash games are solid, but the real gem is the daily $30 tournament. Especially on Friday and Saturday nights... it gets packed, the energy is great, and it's probably one of the best entertainment values you'll find in Austin. I've spent countless evenings there and never regretted showing up.

I've improved my poker game a ton because of this place, met some great people, and always leave in a better mood than when I walked in. Can't recommend Shuffle enough." (Rahul R, 5/5)
